summary_1line: Sita, held captive by Ravana, mourns in despair, recalling Rama and likened through many metaphors to things ruined, lost, or eclipsed.

image_candidates.scene_text: Sita sits on the bare ground in soiled cloth, shrinking away as the richly adorned Ravana gazes at her among looming female demons.
The sorrowful Sita rocks back and forth beneath guard, thin and tearful, imagining Rama while surrounded by dark rakshasi attendants.
A forlorn Sita, pale and unadorned, resembles a lotus stalk stained with mud, sitting alone on the earth in the demon city.
